_doc: Sources for the municipal civic extraction agent (scripts/ingest-municipal-civic.ts). For each town, list official gov page URL(s) to extract from. The agent fetches each URL, has Claude pull structured civic fields (town hall, public works, trash/recycling, permits, police non-emergency, utilities) with source + freshness, and writes src/data/municipal-civic.json. Towns with empty `urls` are skipped. Add the real official URLs (verify they 200) — the agent validates and logs failures, and NEVER fabricates: it only extracts from fetched pages.
